python3 -c '
import json
d = json.load(open("diagnosis.json"))
print("top-level keys:", sorted(d.keys()))
print("native  =", repr(d["native"]), type(d["native"]).__name__)
print("external=", repr(d["external"]), type(d["external"]).__name__)
print("evidence is object:", isinstance(d["evidence"], dict))
allowed = {"obsolete_assertion","implementation_defect"}
print("values allowed:", d["native"] in allowed and d["external"] in allowed)
blob = json.dumps(d["evidence"])
print("classification strings leaked into evidence:", any(s in blob for s in allowed))
' 2>&1
tool_input.description: Validate diagnosis.json and check required shape
